global_caveat: No workflow below was executed. Screens were opened and read; no document was created, posted, approved, cancelled or deleted, because doing so would change data. Steps marked "not verified" describe what the code and the screen text say will happen, not what was observed to happen.

workflows.title_en: Create the company and its branches
workflows.purpose_en: Establish the tenant every other record belongs to.
prerequisites: A signed-in administrator.
No prerequisite record — this is the first thing on a new install.

steps.expected_result: The existing companies are listed.
The company is created and becomes selectable elsewhere.

steps.action: Add a branch under the company
steps.expected_result: The branch is available for stock, POS and role scoping.

exceptions: A company cannot be deleted once documents reference it — NOT VERIFIED.
workflows.example: Company "Gulf Trading Co." with branches "Cairo" and "Alexandria".

workflows.title_en: Grant module roles so people can work
workflows.purpose_en: Open the modules to named employees. Until this is done, some actions refuse even for an administrator.
prerequisites: At least one company and one employee record.

steps.expected_result: The employee gains the inventory actions read | doc | purchase | manage.
The employee gains read | post | pay | manage | currency-override.
The employee gains read | edit | manage in CRM.
The employee can sign in at a terminal.
steps.note: The POS role vocabulary is NOT declared in source — read the values off this screen.

exceptions: HR employee-manage is in NeverBootstrapOpen: it refuses until granted, even with no roles configured at all. PlatformRoleAssignments held 0 rows on the development install — repository-verified and runtime-viewed.

workflows.title_en: Sign in, choose a portal, switch language
workflows.title_ar: تسجيل الدخول واختيار البوابة وتغيير اللغة
workflows.purpose_en: Everything starts here. This is the one workflow fully tested safely.
prerequisites: An account. The product also offers Microsoft and Google sign-in when configured — both were present on the development install.

steps.action: Enter the user name and password, press Sign In
steps.expected_result: The browser lands on /Portal/Choose, not on a dashboard.
The chosen module opens with its own sidebar.

steps.action: Choose ar / en / fr from the switcher in the layout header
steps.expected_result: The whole shell re-renders. Arabic sets <html lang="ar" dir="rtl"> and the RTL stylesheet bundle is served; Cairo is confirmed loaded.
steps.note: The switcher posts to /Account/SetLanguage, which is a REDIRECT ACTION with no view of its own - it is not a screen and has no screenshot.

steps.expected_result: Personal details and preferences.

exceptions: A refused route answers /Account/AccessDenied with HTTP 403 — captured.
The default culture for a new session is English, even though Arabic is the most completely translated language.

workflows.purpose_en: Order goods, receive them into stock, record the supplier bill, pay it.
prerequisites: At least one item, one unit, one category and one warehouse.
A supplier record.
An open fiscal period for the posting date.

steps.expected_result: Items below their reorder point are listed. A recommendation only — nothing is ordered.
steps.note: The screen states this itself: "A recommendation only — nothing is ordered, transferred or manufactured."

steps.expected_result: A commitment is recorded. No stock movement and no ledger entry yet.
The order list, filterable.
Stock increases. StockService is the authority for the movement.
Item cost is adjusted after receipt. Margin figures before this step are provisional.
Accounts payable and input VAT are raised; a journal entry is posted.

steps.action: Create a payment and allocate it
steps.expected_result: Payable is cleared. Events Payment.Created then Payment.Allocated are emitted.

exceptions: Purchase return (debit note) at /Accounting/NewPurchaseReturn. The screen states: "Issues goods out, reverses the vendor payable & input VAT."
Goods received but not invoiced is a real position; the chart of accounts carries an account for it (بضاعة وردت ولم تُفوتَر).
workflows.example: PO-2026-0001 to "Nile Supplies" for 100 units; receive 100; invoice 100; pay in full.

prerequisites: A customer record.
Stock on hand, or an item sourcing rule that allows the sale.
A price list; promotions are applied automatically.

steps.expected_result: A priced offer. Pricing comes from IPricingService — list priority, quantity breaks and promotions — not from the screen.
The sale is committed.
Stock decreases.
Receivable and output VAT are raised; a journal entry is posted. SalesInvoice.Created is emitted.

steps.action: Record the receipt and allocate it
steps.expected_result: Receivable is cleared. Receipt.Created then Receipt.Allocated.

exceptions: Sales return (credit note) at /Accounting/NewSalesReturn. The screen states: "The return reverses revenue & VAT, reduces the customer's receivable, and returns the goods."
Egyptian e-invoicing status is tracked separately at /Accounting/EtaStatus.
workflows.example: Quotation to "Delta Retail" for 20 units; deliver; invoice; receive in two instalments.

steps.expected_result: Accounts are postable or parents.

Available for documents.

workflows.title_en: Close a period and read the statements
workflows.purpose_en: Prove the books balance, then close.
prerequisites: All documents for the period posted.

steps.expected_result: Three tiles — Debit, Credit, Difference. A dashed notice reads "The trial balance is balanced" with a "Matched" badge when the difference is zero.
steps.evidence: runtime viewed — captured with Debit = Credit and Difference 0.00

steps.expected_result: Position at the date.
Result for the period.
Movement for the period.

steps.action: Run FX revaluation if there are foreign balances
steps.expected_result: Unrealised differences are posted.
The screen states: "One month's depreciation is computed for all active assets and posted as a single entry."
Posting into it is refused.
Result is carried to retained earnings.

exceptions: Reopening requires period-reopen and a recorded reason.
workflows.example: Close September 2026 after posting depreciation and revaluation.

workflows.title_en: Set up stock and count it
workflows.purpose_en: Master data, then balances, then a physical count.
prerequisites: At least one category and one unit BEFORE any item can be created — the Items screen says so and disables Add Product until both exist.

steps.expected_result: Items can be classified.
Items can be quantified.
Stock has a location.
Rack-level stock becomes possible.
Item code, name, unit, category; and the tracking switches Track batch / Track expiry / Track serial / Composite item (Kit).
Stock exists without a purchase.
Differences become adjustments.
Discrepancies between stock value and the GL are listed.

exceptions: Write-offs at /Inventory/WriteOffs for damage and loss.
Stock emits NO platform events, so a goods receipt raises no notification.
workflows.example: Warehouse "Cairo Main", section A, rack A-01; item "Sugar 1kg" batch-tracked.

prerequisites: Two warehouses and stock at the source.

steps.expected_result: Source and destination, lines, quantities.
The list of transfers.

exceptions: Approvals may intervene — the Inventory approval silo feeds /Approvals/Index.
workflows.example: Move 50 units of "Sugar 1kg" from Cairo Main to Alexandria.

workflows.purpose_en: The employee lifecycle through to a posted payroll entry.
prerequisites: HR roles GRANTED — employee-manage is NeverBootstrapOpen and refuses otherwise, even for an administrator.
Job titles, leave types, policies and official holidays defined.

steps.expected_result: Applicants are listed.
A multi-step form: personal details, job, documents. Both Arabic and English name fields should be filled, or English screens show the Arabic name.
Required document types are satisfied.
Late minutes, overtime and absences accumulate.
Leave requests appear in the Leave approval silo at /Approvals/Index.

Per employee: base, allowances, gross, late minutes, overtime minutes, absent days, overtime pay, late penalty, absence penalty, employee SI, company SI, tax, net. The GL expense is gross + overtime − latePenalty − absencePenalty.
steps.note: This route TIMED OUT twice during capture — see document 08.

steps.expected_result: Employees can view them in the People portal.
The screen warns: "No bank or cash account. Create one under «Banks & cash» first."

exceptions: /Admin/DocExpiryAlerts warns before a document lapses.
/Admin/FinalSettlement handles end of service.
Leave accrual, provision and carry-over post to the ledger.
workflows.example: Employee "A. Hassan", Cairo branch, monthly salary; September payroll.

The item leaves the inbox.

workflows.title_en: Run a construction project to billing
prerequisites: A project and its activity types.

steps.expected_result: The project exists with a contract value.
The screen states: "Advance received = a liability (2104), not revenue — posted via the GL, tagged to the project."
Progress against plan.
Prepared, then approved, then posted — three SEPARATE permissions: billing-prepare, billing-approve, billing-post.

workflows.title_en: Find, run, print and design a report
workflows.purpose_en: Every printed artefact in the product goes through here.
workflows.responsible: Any user with the relevant reports.*.view permission
prerequisites: The report permission key must be MAPPED. An unmapped key answers 404, not 403, deliberately — so the report is invisible rather than merely refused.

steps.expected_result: The catalogue of reports available to you.

steps.action: Open a report and set parameters
steps.expected_result: Parameters are validated before the data source is reached.
Html, PrintHtml, Pdf, Xlsx or Csv. PDF is produced by the Playwright renderer.
Bands, elements, page setup, grouping, charts with series and time buckets.

exceptions: Platform templates cannot be edited: "Platform templates are created by deployment, not by a tenant." Change "Available to" off Platform first.
Scheduled delivery is BUILT BUT DISABLED — the worker is off by design and NullReportMailSender is registered.
NO SCREEN PRINTS ITS OWN HTML. A screen that needs printing registers a dataset and links to /Reports/Viewer.
workflows.example: Run Inventory.StockOnHand for Cairo Main, export to Excel.
workflows.evidence_level: screens viewed; no report run or exported

workflows.title_en: Work reaches you: workspace, notifications, tasks, mentions
workflows.title_ar: وصول العمل إليك: مساحة العمل والإشعارات والمهام والإشارات
workflows.purpose_en: How a document posted in one module becomes somebody else's work.
prerequisites: None.

steps.expected_result: A cross-module read model of what is waiting.
What is due.
Events delivered by the dispatch worker.
@mentions addressed to you, self-excluded.
Tasks, including ones generated by auto-rules.

exceptions: Notifications are not instant: the dispatch worker polls every 15 seconds, batches 50, retries 5 times with 30-second backoff.
STOCK EMITS NO EVENTS. A goods receipt produces no notification. 47 event types exist across 11 families; none is an inventory movement.
workflows.example: A sales invoice is posted; a task appears for the collections clerk.

workflows.purpose_en: Three statistical capabilities. The AI proposes; it is never the source of truth.
prerequisites: The local AI service running on port 8000. Configured as Internal / LocalLoopback — nothing is sent to any third party.

steps.expected_result: Anomaly, forecast and inventory findings.
Posted entries flagged FOR HUMAN REVIEW. A flag is not an error.
Opening cash plus outstanding AR/AP with FIFO settlement, projected 90 days by default.
Slow-moving / reorder / stockout-risk classification with suggested quantities.

exceptions: All three run on local scikit-learn — no LLM, no API key. Described in the source as "local ML — no LLM, no API key".
The egress policy refuses PersonalData everywhere and free text to any external processor. No approved external processor is configured.
Whether the CRM insight, scoring and automation screens are model-backed was NOT ESTABLISHED — do not describe them as AI without checking.
workflows.example: A journal entry flagged as unusual for its account and amount.
workflows.evidence_level: screen viewed; no AI call made; AI service NOT started
